### Motivation

<!-- Please outline the motivation for the proposal.

If this is related to another issue, please link here too. -->

Preventing search results from certain websites, equivalent to the effect of using advanced search operators like `"some_kind_of_query -site:some_website"` is needed especially in evaluating deep research agents when the corresponding benchmarks have a leak (e.g., on Hugging Face).

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it requests a feature for the SearchToolkit tool used by agents, specifically to control tool invocation behavior (filtering search results), which falls under "Tool configuration issues" in the agent issue taxonomy.
